objective: Implement a governed revision-aware macro vintage model that preserves every release/revision and resolves historical values strictly as-of simulated decision time without look-ahead leakage.
scope: Define immutable macro vintage records with observation, release and observed-at time semantics
Preserve initial release and every later revision as separate vintages
Require deterministic contiguous revision numbering per series observation
Require non-decreasing release and observed-at times across revisions
Resolve as-of values only when both release_time and observed_at are not later than decision time
Provide deterministic series snapshots as-of decision time without future revision leakage
Preserve exact P06-D dataset-version and P06-A raw-lineage references
Compute deterministic vintage IDs and store fingerprints independent of input ordering
Bound vintage count through policy and fail closed on duplicate/revision inconsistencies
Reconcile P06-E active task/lock state across GitHub and Linear
out_of_scope: Selecting a production database/object store/cloud vendor
Live macro-provider acquisition, credentials or network connectivity
Trading, order execution, KYC, funding or production activation
dependencies: P06-C Time-Series Optimized Query Layer CANONICAL_COMPLETE
P02-C macro-vintage and replay anti-lookahead architecture frozen
Fresh Live Guard: no active task, active lock or open PR at execution start
tests: Strict Pyright passes for P06 product source
Initial release and later revisions remain separate immutable vintages
As-of before initial release returns no value
As-of after initial release but before revision returns initial vintage
Revision released but not yet observed does not leak into replay
As-of after revision observed returns revised vintage
Series snapshot resolves each observation independently as-of decision time
Revision numbers must start at zero and be contiguous
Release and observed-at times cannot move backward across revisions
Vintage/store fingerprint is deterministic and input-order independent
Fingerprint changes when macro value or lineage changes
Dataset-version and raw-lineage SHA-256 references are validated
No production provider/database/cloud client import exists in historical-data core
P06-E evidence is byte-identical across two runs
security_tests: No credential or network access is required
Replay eligibility requires release_time <= decision_time AND observed_at <= decision_time
Future revisions never replace historical as-of truth
Production macro storage vendor remains NOT_SELECTED
rollback: Revert the P06-E macro-vintage module, policy, tests, deterministic evidence/CI wiring and P06-E active-state reconciliation. P06-A/B/C/D remain canonical; no production provider/vendor, credential, network connection or trading state is changed.
definition_of_ready: No active governed task or lock at Fresh Live Guard
No open pull request conflicting with shared state
